description: This file defines a factory class 'FormatterFactory' used for creating formatter instances based on source and formatter names within SuiteCRM. It manages loading formatter classes dynamically, handling custom and default formatter paths, and caches formatter instances for reuse.

classes.name: FormatterFactory
classes.description: A static factory class responsible for instantiating and caching formatter objects based on source and formatter names. It handles locating formatter class files, defaulting to a standard formatter when custom ones are not found, and integrates with the ConnectorFactory to manage component instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a formatter instance for the specified source and formatter name. Loads the necessary formatter class file if not cached, sets up the template file, and associates the component instance.
